461:t_1:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「As I figured, Tokyo's a big city on both Earths!」

461:t_1:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Is this really okay, $$勝平$$...? Leaving the $$クラッシャー隊$$ base without permission.」

461:t_1:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「Who cares? Everybody else is back in Japan for the first time in ages, and it sounds like they've all got errands to run.」

461:t_1:7.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$n and $$甲児$$ and everyone from $$エレメント$$ seemed to be talking about something the whole time...」

461:t_1:8.en:
$$勝平$$
「They're probably discussing Big Bro $n's training to stop being the quiet type.」

461:t_1:9.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$シンジ$$ and the rest of the EVA team seemed to be in their own rooms, though...」

461:t_1:10.en:
$$勝平$$
「Sis $$葵$$ and the others are off doing their own thing too, right?」

461:t_1:11.en:
$$正太郎$$
「To me, the way $$シンジ$$ and the others get along now looks different from before...」

461:t_1:12.en:
$$勝平$$
「That's puberty for you. Big Bro $$桂$$ said so.」

461:t_1:14.en:
$$勝平$$
「Forget about everybody else for now. I'm gonna enjoy every bit of my free time!」

461:t_1:15.en:
$$正太郎$$
「But $$宇宙太$$ and $$恵子$$ are helping out at $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$.」

461:t_1:16.en:
$$勝平$$
「They used to be special employees, you know. I guess they've got stuff to do, one way or another.」

461:t_1:17.en:
$$正太郎$$
「You were one too, though, $$勝平$$.」

461:t_1:18.en:
$$勝平$$
「Don't say that to me. I can't do invoice processing anyway.」

461:t_1:19.en:
$$勝平$$
「$$ワッ太$$, the Exec. Director and the Managing Director got called to $$２１世紀警備保障$$ HQ, so Big Bro $$木下$$ and the others left behind have to do the work.」

461:t_1:20.en:
$$正太郎$$
「To $$２１世紀警備保障$$...? What in the world for...?」

461:t_1:23.en:
$$勝平$$
「But hey, $$正太郎$$... You've been giving me a hard time this whole time, but what about you?」

461:t_1:24.en:
$$勝平$$
「Sneaking out of $c by yourself for a secret date with $$マッキー$$?」

461:t_1:25.en:
$$正太郎$$
「...That's what I wanted to talk about, $$勝平$$... Shall we go our separate ways from here?」

461:t_1:27.en:
$$正太郎$$
「...The truth is, Director $$大塚$$ asked me to do something, and I'm in the middle of that mission.」

461:t_1:30.en:
$$勝平$$
「Don't be so stiff. If there's anything I can help with, I'll lend a hand.」

461:t_1:32.en:
???
「...Is it about looking into my background, by any chance?」

461:t_1:35.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$梅本$$... You knew I was tailing you?」

461:t_1:36.en:
$$梅本$$
「I'm fairly used to being followed.」

461:t_1:37.en:
$$勝平$$
「$$正太郎$$'s mission was tailing Uncle $$梅本$$!?」

461:t_1:38.en:
$$梅本$$
「I'd guess Director $$大塚$$ or someone like that asked you to.」

461:t_1:39.en:
$$正太郎$$
「...I'm sorry, $$梅本$$. You've helped us so many times, and I still acted as if I suspected you.」

461:t_1:40.en:
$$梅本$$
「There's no need to worry. It's my fault for contacting the $$連邦軍$$ without revealing my background.」

461:t_1:41.en:
$$梅本$$
「As a commander, it's perfectly natural for you to doubt me.」

461:t_1:44.en:
$$梅本$$
「Had I been an agent of evil, $$勝平$$ would surely be saddened...」

461:t_1:45.en:
$$梅本$$
「You thought that and tried to carry out the mission alone. I salute you for it.」

461:t_1:47.en:
$$梅本$$
「I've already done what I had to do... I've entrusted everything to you and $$ワッ太$$, so there's nothing left to hide.」

461:t_1:48.en:
$$梅本$$
「Indulge me and listen to a story from my past.」

461:t_1:50.en:
$$梅本$$
「Yes... It's a tale of a homeland I can never return to.」

461:t_1:54.en:
$$梅本$$
「...Earth's seas are beautiful. The blue sea and the green sea, both are wonderful.」

461:t_1:55.en:
$$勝平$$
「Uncle... I hear you went to $$翠の地球$$ while I was gone and met Big Bro $$一太郎$$ and the others.」

461:t_1:56.en:
$$梅本$$
「$$一太郎$$, huh...? If he keeps growing like this, he looks set to become a fine engineer.」

461:t_1:57.en:
$$正太郎$$
「...$$梅本$$. I hear that ever since the Empire attacked Earth, you've been helping Earth's side in all sorts of places.」

461:t_1:58.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I hear that much of it was technical assistance, and that all of it is the product of technology different from Earth's.」

461:t_1:60.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Director $$大塚$$ of the Far East Branch is very grateful to you.」

461:t_1:61.en:
$$正太郎$$
「But you never talk about yourself, $$梅本$$, so I couldn't help getting worried...」

461:t_1:62.en:
$$梅本$$
「As I said before, I have no intention of blaming Director $$大塚$$.」

461:t_1:63.en:
$$正太郎$$
「...Then I'll ask. $$梅本$$... are you not from Earth?」

461:t_1:65.en:
$$梅本$$
「My real name is $$ナバロン$$... I'm a native of $$ガバール星$$.」

461:t_1:67.en:
$$梅本$$
「$$ガバール星$$ is a nation of robots, ruled by the mother computer $$シグマ$$.」

461:t_1:68.en:
$$梅本$$
「There I did research day and night to build powerful robots.」

461:t_1:69.en:
$$梅本$$
「But I grew to hate what I was doing, and fled $$ガバール星$$.」

461:t_1:70.en:
$$勝平$$
「What was all that for, anyway?」

461:t_1:71.en:
$$梅本$$
「$$シグマ$$'s orders were to create powerful combat robots, and the robots developed that way were used as tools to invade other planets.」

461:t_1:72.en:
$$梅本$$
「But what I wanted to build was no mere weapon. I... wanted to build a real robot.」

461:t_1:75.en:
$$梅本$$
「When I escaped from $$ガバール星$$, all I had in my head was a vague image...」

461:t_1:76.en:
$$梅本$$
「It took shape only after I met $$竹尾道太郎$$ on this Earth.」

461:t_1:78.en:
$$梅本$$
「I had an accident in space and he saved me. So I could live on Earth, I was given the name $$梅本$$.」

461:t_1:79.en:
$$梅本$$
「To repay his kindness, I developed a single robot.」

461:t_1:81.en:
$$梅本$$
「$$竹尾$$ had said he'd use a robot to start an odd-jobs business. I thought it would come in handy for that.」

461:t_1:82.en:
$$勝平$$
「Then is $$トライダー$$ the real robot you're talking about, Uncle?」

461:t_1:83.en:
$$梅本$$
「I had no such intention while building it. But $$竹尾$$'s joy when he saw the finished $$トライダー$$, and...」

461:t_1:84.en:
$$梅本$$
「Seeing his son $$ワッ太$$ as well, I became convinced that I had built a real robot.」

461:t_1:85.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Just what is this real robot you speak of?」

ガバール星.evidence: Trider G7's home planet of Navaron/Umemoto, ruled by Mother Computer Sigma; sheet has Gabarnium (ガバールニウム) from the same source. English form is a proposal.

シグマ.evidence: Mother computer that rules the robot nation of Gabar in Invincible Robot Trider G7 (マザーコンピュータ・シグマ).

トライダー.evidence: Bare short form of トライダーＧ７ (Trider G7), used by Kappei and Umemoto.

竹尾.evidence: Bare surname of Michitaro Takeo, Watta's father (sheet has 竹尾ワッ太, 竹尾しげる etc.).

竹尾道太郎.evidence: Watta's father (Shotaro: ワッ太のお父さん); sheet has 道太郎 = Michitaro and the family name 竹尾.
